2026.headline: 74.52, the week's lowest score, and the bench that outscored the margin
story: CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were seriously 23 rounds, played through round 11, and let the robot finish the draft, which gave him twelve autopicks. The first-round pick was James Cook, followed by CeeDee Lamb at 2.02 and Bo Nix at 3.02.

Week 4 brought 183.42, the high score of the week. Week 5 brought 74.52, the lowest score of the week, a 121.98 to 74.52 loss to fumbduckdumbfuck, 47.98 left on the bench and James Cook at 22.8 as the MVP. Sleeper's weekly report says he scored 61% of his perfect lineup. CeeDee Lamb came up in the chat, but he did not lead the lineup.
At 2-3 he fell three spots to 8th. FAAB is a full $500 and the 1.06 is his. The desk's view is the same as before: the roster is fine and the lineup is the problem.
takes: Depth first, spending never, and the bench in charge.
It works, until it does not.
